en.bdb: Joy and teachings of the Sikh life

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਖਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa sikhanaa gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat dhee sevaa|

en.bdb: The way of learning the conduct of a Sikh of the Guru is that one should be the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਨ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਗੀਤਾ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhas avataar na sikhiaa geetaa gosaT alakh abhevaa|

en.bdb: This mystery was not known even to the ten incarnations (of Visrnu); this mystery is beyond the Gita and discussions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਣਨ ਭੇਦ ਕਿਹੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਣੁ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: vedh na jaanan bhedh kih likh paR sun san dhevee dhevaa|

en.bdb: Then the Vedas know not its secret though they are studied by gods and godesses.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤ ਲੰਘਾਇਨਿ ਖੇਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: sidh naath na samaadh vich ta(n)t na ma(n)t la(n)ghain khevaa|

en.bdb: The deep meditations of the siddhs, naths and even the tantta­tras could not cross the teachings and practices of Sikh way of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਨ ਗਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਟੇਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh bhagat jagat vich likh na ge gur sikhee Tevaa|

en.bdb: Millions of devotees flourished in this World but they also could not understand the life-discipline of the Sikhs of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਲਾ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਮੇਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: silaa aloonee chaTanee saadh na pujai lakh lakh mevaa|

en.bdb: This life is similar the licking of the saltless stone but its taste is incomparable even to the millions of fruits.
Absorption in the word of the Guru in the holy congregation is the accomplishment of the life of a gursikh.
